verdict.rationale: Featurebase centralizes feedback into a single portal and exposes a Reports API built on its analytics engine, and it references user attributes for segmentation, suggesting some customer context is available alongside feedback. However, there is no explicit evidence of enriched customer profile data (e.g., plan tier, revenue, company size, usage) surfaced directly next to feedback items for prioritization decisions. Missing for 10: explicit customer-context fields joined to feedback records, prioritization scoring based on customer value, and independent confirmation of this workflow.
